reason: The original protocol froze late-capture exclusion and fair Energy Score but did not specify the last permissible delayed-run day or a computationally feasible deterministic pair-sampling design for a 100,000-member Energy Score. These details are fixed before the first capture and before election results are known.
primary_scoring_effect: NONE. Mean party-level fair CRPS, its availability condition, the final date, and the winner rule are unchanged.

late_capture_limit.rule: A delayed scheduled job may create its immutable LATE_EXCLUDED record only on the immediately following Europe/Stockholm calendar day. Any later attempt is a prohibited retroactive capture and must not write or index a slot.
late_capture_limit.rationale: This honors the requirement to retain a delayed next-day scheduled run without permitting missing older slots to be reconstructed later.

fair_energy_score_computation.estimator: uniform ordered-distinct-pair Monte Carlo estimate of the preregistered fair U-statistic pair expectation
fair_energy_score_computation.distance: Euclidean norm over M,L,C,KD,S,V,MP,SD percentage points in the frozen order
fair_energy_score_computation.reporting: Label the Energy Score as a Monte Carlo estimate, record sample size and seed, and never use it in place of exact mean fair CRPS for the primary winner.
fair_energy_score_computation.v_statistic_sensitivity: Use the same distinct-pair sample and multiply its mean by (n-1)/n before the one-half pair term.

source_timestamp_semantics.rule: A source-reported timestamp without a UTC offset is preserved verbatim and explicitly labelled timezone-unspecified. It is not converted to UTC by assumption. HTTP Last-Modified remains separate transport metadata.
